openHouses.description: 35 Marcourt is a picture perfect colonial tucked away in a peaceful wooded setting located in the coveted Dodge Farm neighborhood. This home is filled with character, charm and architectural details making it one-of-a-kind. Living room with a beamed ceiling, custom built-ins and a fireplace. Spectacular family room is flooded with light from skylights in the cathedral ceiling, three walls of windows and doors to the patio. It's a move-in ready gem just minutes from the village and train.
